slide_title: Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance

layout.arrangement: Title spans top-left to center; yellow slide-number circle at extreme top-right. Below title, a horizontal band holds the confusion matrix (far left), the text 'Threshold=0.5' (center-left), and a beige flowchart container (right). The lower ~60% of the slide is dominated by a horizontal predicted-value axis with airplane icons arranged above it.

regions.name: title
regions.content: Main title in bold dark red

regions.name: confusion_matrix
regions.content: 2x2 contingency table with TP/FN/FP/TN and counts 4/1/1/5

regions.name: flowchart
regions.content: Cream container with Test Sample → Model → Threshold → Class I/II flow

regions.content: Horizontal 0.0–1.0 axis with tick marks, dashed 0.5 line, red marker, and airplane icons above

layout.hierarchy: Title is largest and boldest. The dark-red 'Model' box and beige flowchart form the secondary focal point. The axis and airplane field provide the visual foundation. The confusion matrix is smallest and most detailed.

visual_elements.description: Confusion matrix. Column header 'Predicted as' spans P and N. Row header 'Actual' labels P and N rows. Cell (Actual P, Predicted P) = TP with value 4, light green fill. Cell (Actual P, Predicted N) = FN with value 1, light red/pink fill. Cell (Actual N, Predicted P) = FP with value 1, light red/pink fill. Cell (Actual N, Predicted N) = TN with value 5, light green fill.

Left-to-right pipeline inside a cream rounded rectangle. 'Test Sample' box (with small plane thumbnail) → thick arrow → 'Model' box (dark red fill, white bold text, small ROC-curve icon) with sub-caption '[Any value] — (0, +1)' beneath → arrow labeled '(0 — 1)' → 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)' box → two branching arrows to 'Class I' (light green, upper right) and 'Class II' (light pink, lower right).

Horizontal predicted-value number line from 0.0 to 1.0 in dark red with minor tick marks and major labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.5, 1.0. A vertical dashed line at 0.5 (dark blue) intersects the axis at a solid red circle. Above the axis sit two rough rows of gray airplane outline icons: planes left of 0.5 are plain; planes right of 0.5 display a skull-and-crossbones decal.

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is large (~32pt) bold dark red. Flowchart box text is mixed case; 'Model' is white bold. Confusion-matrix labels TP/FN/FP/TN are small caps with colored fills; counts 4/1/1/5 are bold black. Axis labels are small dark red. No serif fonts observed.
animation_state: Static; no mid-build indicators. The red dot at 0.5 denotes the currently selected threshold value.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white. 2. Add title 'Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance' top-left in bold dark red (#8B0000), ~32pt. 3. Place a yellow (#FFFF00) circle at top-right containing '24' in black. 4. Build the confusion matrix at top-left: header 'Predicted as' over columns P/N; row header 'Actual' over rows P/N; fill cells TP=4 (light green #90EE90), FN=1 (light red #FFB6C1), FP=1 (light red #FFB6C1), TN=5 (light green #90EE90) with thin black borders. 5. Add bold dark-red text 'Threshold=0.5' just right of the matrix. 6. Draw a large cream (#FFFACD) rounded rectangle in the upper-right. Inside it, left-to-right: a 'Test Sample' box with a small plane icon; a thick arrow to a dark-red (#8B0000) 'Model' box with white text and a small curve icon, plus sub-text '[Any value] — (0, +1)'; an arrow labeled '(0 — 1)' to a 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)' box; two branching arrows to a light-green (#98FB98) 'Class I' box (top) and a light-pink (#FFB6C1) 'Class II' box (bottom). 7. Near the bottom, draw a dark-red horizontal axis labeled 'Predicted' at the left, spanning 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks; label 0.0, 0.5, and 1.0. 8. Add a dark-blue vertical dashed line at 0.5 with a solid red (#FF0000) circle marker on the axis. 9. Scatter gray airplane outline icons in two rows above the axis: plain planes left of 0.5, skull-decalled planes right of 0.5. 10. Ensure all text uses a clean sans-serif font and the overall border is a thin gray rectangle.
